subject: english
stem: A recipe needs one teaspoon of oil. There is a little oil. What is still unknown?
options: whether the amount reaches one teaspoon
whether oil is countable in this sentence
whether a few should replace a little
whether the recipe has any words

optionRationales.reason: whether the amount reaches one teaspoon：a little 只說少量，未給精確量。
whether oil is countable in this sentence：oil 已作不可數。
whether a few should replace a little：a few 不搭 oil。
whether the recipe has any words：與所需量無關。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「依名詞可數性選 a few 或 a little，並辨識帶 a 的少量肯定與不帶 a 的幾乎不足語意。」可推出 whether the amount reaches one teaspoon；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 whether the amount reaches one teaspoon 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
